title: Move eval framework and corpus into the scanner project
description:
Purpose: Evaluation lives next to the scanner, not next to the CLI.

Moves: tests/eval, tests/benchmark (corpus and runner), Plexus-facing features for scanner recall, src/evals if it is scanner scoring.

KDATAP-0dbc61 four-layer work follows this harness.

Definition of done: mention-level T1 and component eval run from the scanner project against the same corpus.
